dcterms:description: The Cornell eRulemaking Corpus (CDCP) consists of 731 user comments from an eRulemaking website, totaling approximately 4,700 propositions, all considered to be argumentative. The argument model adopted is based on directed graphs, with propositions divided into 5 classes: POLICY, VALUE, FACT, TESTIMONY, and REFERENCE.
dcterms:title: Cornell eRulemaking Corpus (CDCP)
